title: The Poisson lifetime serves real sources, and tools.md states the share it serves
goal: Once detect records changed_utc (BG-w3p7fqy2, ST-fxz2wrfe), fetch.py --status shows at least one source whose lifetime basis is the Poisson estimate, and kb/_self/tools.md states the measured share of sources each basis serves with the command that measured it, not 'few'. SP-etslk6yu review: on 2026-10-12 the Poisson branch served 0 of 3972 sources (changed_utc empty in every revision of _fetch_state.csv).

run: import json,subprocess,sys; p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'_tools/fetch.py','--status','--json'],capture_output=True,text=True); p.returncode and sys.exit(2); d=json.loads(p.stdout); sys.exit(0 if any((r.get('lifetime_basis') or '').endswith('(Poisson)') for r in d) else 1)
